name: resinvest-erp-desktop
description: ResInvest ERP - stanowisko serwerowe z wbudowaną bazą danych

scripts.start: npm run prepare:payload && npm run rebuild:local && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:payload && npm run prepare:native && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist:dir: npm run prepare:payload && npm run prepare:native && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
